sources.snippet: About The Project Most guides say Qwen-Image 2.1 needs 32 GB or more. The full bf16 checkpoint is 33 GB, and the text encoder alone is 17.5 GB. This project gets the whole pipeline under 12 GB of peak memory and brings an image edit down from about 25 minutes to under 3, with a local web studio on top.
